content.rendered:
“Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.” (2 Kings 5: 14)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

Naaman washed in Jordan for seven times, and his flesh became new. He completed Elisha’s instruction, and his skin was restored. Naaman did not stop on the way while washing in Jordan. His skin didn’t become new immediately he began washing himself in Jordan, but he didn’t stop.

Friend, taking the right steps may not immediately reward you with right results, but God says, don’t stop. Doing what is right in God’s sight may not immediately turn things around in your life, family, career, business, ministry, etc, but God says, keep doing what is right. Being upright in your dealings with men may not bring immediate results, but keep being upright in all your ways.

Naaman didn’t get results the first time he washed in Jordan, he began doing God’s will but the results didn’t come immediately. The fact that your result has not come does not mean that you are not on the right path. If you are doing God’s will and doing what is right, keep doing it.

Naaman fulfilled Elisha’s instruction of washing in Jordan for seven times, and his skin became new. He kept doing what God wanted him to do, and he got an amazing miracle. If you keep doing what God wants you to do, you will step into results that will amaze you and shock everyone around you.

Keep doing what is right until it gives you results; keep praying, keep speaking and believing God’s word, keep sowing seeds, keep walking in righteousness, keep doing what God wants you to do, keep doing what is right. If Jehovah is involved, your right steps will bring the right results.

Pray With Me: Lord, I won’t stop until the right steps give me the right results, in Jesus’ name!
